name: Shirudaku!? Soredemo Tsuyoki na Princess! "Ii kara Tottoto Chitsunai Shasei Shinasai tteba!"
original_name: 汁だくッ！？ それでも強気なプリンセス！ 「いいからとっとと膣内射精しなさいってば！」
source:
A leftover princess spirit, Elyse, refuses to leave the protagonist's house. Her goal is to feed on the power of the living, not because she wants to be with anyone, she insists... but her superficial shyness is starkly contrasted by her abandoned, gutbucking, juice-gushing sexual days with him.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ060061.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
迟迟不肯离去的公主幽灵艾莉洁赖在主人公家里。她坚称自己的目标只是吸取活人的力量，绝不是因为想和谁待在一起……然而，她表面上的羞涩，与两人独处时彻底放纵、深入撞击、淫液四溅的性爱生活形成了鲜明反差。

[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ060061.html]DLsite English[/url]]
